paragraphs.en: Android skills are a dedicated repository of AI-optimized, modular instructions and resources, to help agents better understand and execute specific patterns that follow the best practices and guidance on Android development from developer.android.com .
paragraphs.zh: Android 技能是一个专门的代码库，包含经过 AI 优化的模块化指令和资源，旨在帮助智能体更好地理解和执行特定模式，这些模式遵循 developer.android.com 上关于 Android 开发的最佳实践和指南。

paragraphs.en: Android skills follow the open-standard agent skills - markdown files (SKILL.md) that provide a technical specification of a task, and ground LLMs with information on specialized domains and workflows.
paragraphs.zh: Android 技能遵循开放标准的智能体技能——即 markdown 文件（SKILL.md），它们提供任务的技术规范，并为大语言模型提供专业领域和工作流程方面的信息基础。

paragraphs.en: Our Android skill development focuses on use cases and workflows where evaluations show LLMs underperform . We aren't prioritizing well-established areas where LLMs are already proficient, such as basic Jetpack Compose best practices.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的 Android 技能开发聚焦于评估显示大语言模型表现欠佳的用例和工作流。 我们不会优先考虑大语言模型已经十分擅长的成熟领域，例如基础的 Jetpack Compose 最佳实践。

paragraphs.en: To learn more, read the official documentation:
paragraphs.zh: 欲了解更多，请阅读官方文档：

paragraphs.en: Use Android CLI to install a specific skill into the current directory:
paragraphs.zh: 使用 Android CLI 将特定技能安装到当前目录：

paragraphs.en: android skills add r8-analyzer --project=. Use Android CLI to install all Android skills to directories for all detected agents:
paragraphs.zh: android skills add r8-analyzer --project=. 使用 Android CLI 将所有 Android 技能安装到目录，供所有检测到的智能体使用：

sents.en: Use Android CLI to install all Android skills to directories for all detected agents:
sents.zh: 使用 Android CLI 将所有 Android 技能安装到目录，供所有检测到的智能体使用：

paragraphs.en: android skills add --all If you don't have any existing agent directories and don't specify particular agents, the skills will be installed for Gemini and Antigravity at ~/.gemini/antigravity/skills .
paragraphs.zh: android skills add --all 如果你没有任何现有的智能体目录，也未指定特定的智能体，技能将被安装到 Gemini 和 Antigravity 的 ~/.gemini/antigravity/skills 目录中。

paragraphs.en: To update all skills or specific ones, run:
paragraphs.zh: 要更新所有技能或特定技能，请运行：

paragraphs.en: android skills update --all android skills update wear-compose-m3 Install as an agent plugin Claude Code :
paragraphs.zh: android skills update --all android skills update wear-compose-m3 作为智能体插件安装 Claude Code :

paragraphs.en: /plugin marketplace add android/skills /plugin install android-skills@android-skills Codex:
paragraphs.zh: /plugin marketplace add android/skills /plugin install android-skills@android-skills Codex:

paragraphs.en: codex plugin marketplace add android/skills codex plugin add android-skills@android-skills Activate skills Your agent automatically activates skills that are relevant to your task. To use a skill, prompt your agent to complete a task that is related to the skill, for example "Make my app UI edge-to-edge." The agent should automatically find and use the skill if it has been installed.
paragraphs.zh: codex 插件市场 add android/skills codex 插件 add android-skills@android-skills 激活技能 你的智能体会自动激活与你的任务相关的技能。 要使用某个技能，只需提示你的智能体完成一项与该技能相关的任务，例如「让我的应用 UI 实现边到边显示」。如果该技能已安装，智能体应当会自动找到并使用它。

sents.en: codex plugin marketplace add android/skills codex plugin add android-skills@android-skills Activate skills Your agent automatically activates skills that are relevant to your task.

sents.en: To use a skill, prompt your agent to complete a task that is related to the skill, for example "Make my app UI edge-to-edge." The agent should automatically find and use the skill if it has been installed.
sents.zh: 要使用某个技能，只需提示你的智能体完成一项与该技能相关的任务，例如「让我的应用 UI 实现边到边显示」。如果该技能已安装，智能体应当会自动找到并使用它。

paragraphs.en: AI can make mistakes, so always double-check the results.
paragraphs.zh: AI 可能会犯错，因此请务必仔细核对结果。

paragraphs.en: Submit a GitHub issue to provide feedback, report issues, or make new skill requests and changes.
paragraphs.zh: 提交 GitHub issue 以提供反馈、报告问题，或提出新的技能请求和变更。
